maria: Quick thread  launch prep for posts + webinar. Top goals: benchmark narrative visibility, webinar signups, and a clean redirect state. Who owns KW clusters, schema, and redirect smoke?

sam: Ill do keyword clusters + meta. will drop a seed CSV with intent tags and demo CTAs by EOD.

olivia: Ill run the redirect diff and internal link pass. propose rule: retire -> 301 to pillar, homepage only if no match. will post CSV to shared drive when ready.

jake: Ill handle JSON-LD for Event + FAQPage. small snippet for the webinar page: ```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Benchmark Webinar","startDate":"2026-05-12T16:00:00Z","organizer":{"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference"}}
```

maria: Timeline: KW seed today, schema draft tomorrow, link+redirect list Thurs. Preflight 24h before publish. Add smoke test example for redirects.

seo-ci-bot: To trigger redirect CI: upload CSV to /marketing/seo/redirects/launch-1768904321.csv. Diff check available.

sam: Seed uploaded: https://drive.redwood.example/seo/seed-1768904321.csv  includes H2 suggestions and CTA per page. DEMO-tagged rows present.

olivia: Redirect sweep plan (short): export current redirect table, diff vs proposed CSV, flag collisions & chains, prepare revert list. smoke test: `curl -I -L https://redwood.ai/old-path` -> expect 200 final URL.

jake: Schema QA: pass Rich Results test, include startDate & organizer, no duplicate @ids. will add a docs pipeline check.

maria: Preflight short list: KW sheet locked, schema validated, internal links implemented, redirect CSV tested, tracking + lead routing verified. Mark done in the sheet.

seo-ci-bot: Preflight status: 1/5 (KW sheet present). Waiting on: schema.jsonld; redirect CSV; internal-link diff; tracking verification.

maria: Thanks team. Update this thread as you make progress and ping #eng-release for staging once redirects are staged.
